reason: My uncle in India handles this kind of thing for family and it costs me nothing but a favour. I'd need a really good reason to pay a stranger a few hundred dollars when someone I know does it.
objection: My relative can sort this out for free, so why would I pay for a company I've never heard of with my parents' property money?
would_change_my_mind: If my relative said the informal route was risky or unavailable for a sum this size, and I could verify the FINTRAC registration and bank partner myself and talk to the CA before paying anything.
